messages.subject: facet_grid and multiple time series in each panel
parts:
Hello there,

I'm trying to plot multiple time series classified by the variable
group into different panels. The following self contained example
demonstrates this:

Say we have 50 time series divided into 5 groups where each time
series consists of 15 measurements. I would like to plot this as
follows:

dat <- data.frame(id=rep(1:50,each=15),
group=rep(rep(1:5,each=10),each=15), time=rep(1:15,50), value =
rnorm(50*15), col = factor(sample(1:4,15*50,replace=TRUE)))

p <- ggplot(dat,aes(x=time,y=value,group=id,color=col)) +
geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +facet_grid(.~group)

print(p)

However this results in a data display with 50 instead of 5 panels.
That is, each time series is in a separate plot/panel instead of
having 10 time series per panel.

Can anyone point me out what I'm doing wrong?

Adrian

You're probably getting in trouble with the name of your grouping
variable, which conflicts with the 'group' aesthetic: try


dat2 <- rename(dat,c(group="group2"))

p2 <- ggplot(dat2,aes(x=time,y=value,group=id,color=col)) +
geom_line(alpha = 0.6) +facet_grid(.~group2)

print(p2)
